name: Date Range
description: Generates one Timestamp row per step between two inclusive bounds. The bounds accept ISO dates or timestamps, the step is a positive interval such as '1 day' or '15 minutes', and the single output column is named date.

start.title: Start
start.description: First timestamp of the range, as an ISO date or timestamp; inclusive.

end.title: End
end.description: Last timestamp of the range, as an ISO date or timestamp; inclusive, not before start.

step.title: Step
step.description: Distance between two rows such as '1 day' or '15 minutes' (a positive count and a unit: second, minute, hour, day, week, month, year).
